dct_description_sm:
This data folder contains:
  1. A database with stocking records for Brook Trout stocked in Ontario waters by the OMNRF since 1905 "BrookTroutStockingDatabase", and an accompanying document which elaborates on the database fields "Data Dictionary";
  2. A mapping application run through the programming language R which maps and queries records in the stocking database "app.R";
  3. A read me file which describes how to run the application (including how to install R and R.Studio) "Read Me"; and
  4. Various tables and shape files that are used by the application as it runs.

Status
Historical archive: Data has been stored in an offline storage facility

Maintenance and Update Frequency
Not Stated
